title: Great for those with adhd
body:
This has helped me to organise my thoughts and clarify emails. I use it as a starting point to review things, it’s like having someone to help gather
Your thoughts and proof read, I use it as a guide and then rewrite using the ideas it comes up with as suggestions and starting points.

title: Avsolutely awesome
body: All these things can ofc be done via chatgpt etc, but having a simple to use tool that wraps it up in a dead simple interface helps! The task breakdown is super, esp the simple way of iterating and adding subtasks. The time estimator is super as I just can not do that by myself. The spicyness level is a nice touch as well, haha. Well worth the money!
